name: arize-agentkit-tracing-demo
description: Next.js demo: Scalekit AgentKit tool executions and OpenAI LLM calls in one Arize AX trace — public-API wrapper, not a prototype patch.

paragraphs: A focused Next.js demo that puts Scalekit AgentKit tool executions and OpenAI (or LiteLLM) LLM calls into a single Arize Phoenix trace — so you can see what an agent actually did, including when a tool failed and the model claimed it succeeded.
Scalekit provides auth and actions on behalf of users, with 500+ connectors and 20,000+ tools.
The integration surface is one file — lib/traced-tools.ts — written against Scalekit’s public API only, so it works as a copy-paste recipe today and can later become a package without a rewrite.
features: Provider auto-instrumentors capture LLM calls, but not tool execution results.
A thin public-API wrapper around ScalekitClient.tools.executeTool can emit OpenInference TOOL spans without patching SDK internals.
Those tool spans share one trace with AGENT + LLM spans when you instrument in-process (no traceparent plumbing to Scalekit).
Failure-inside-data (resolved, not thrown) can be marked as span ERROR so “tool failed / model said OK” is visible.
